## User scenario and change / 场景与改动

## Validation and evidence / 验证及证据

## Unverified items / 未验证项

- [ ] Bilingual parameters, permissions, and meaning agree.
- [ ] Existing IDs and favorites remain compatible.
- [ ] External methods have pinned sources and verified licenses, if applicable.
- [ ] No private history, credentials, or identifying infrastructure data is included.
- [ ] Generated files are rebuilt and `python3 build.py --check` passes.
